Constant decimals (18) used as scaling exponent in init and constructor.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Core transfer path: allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance mutations, sale counter increment.
Whitelist gate bypassing condition() for owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale accounts.
Sale restriction checks against _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.

edges.reason: Constructor derives owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner, so the owner alone can invoke arbitrary delegatecall.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is compared against _from to spend allowance in transferFrom().
transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom().
approve() writes allowance for msg.sender.
delegate() executes a low-level delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a.
The delegatecall hands execution and storage context to externally supplied code.
transferFrom() delegates its authorization decision to the bypassable ensure() whitelist.
ensure() returns true for _from == owner, skipping all sale conditions.
ensure() returns true for _from == tradeAddress, a value the owner can set arbitrarily.
ensure() returns true whenever canSale[_from] is set, bypassing restrictions.
ensure() falls back to condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound per-address sale counts.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale quota.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked addition on the recipient balance.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] without matching decrement semantics.
batchSend() multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow protection, under-charging the sender.
batchSend() debits the sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
batchSend() is an owner-only distribution primitive.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom().
approve() writes the allowance mapping.
setTradeAddress() overwrites tradeAddress, which is trusted by ensure().
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
Local _UNI computed by pairFor() is compared in the ensure() whitelist.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
Parameter _to is consumed by transfer().
transfer() forwards _to into transferFrom().
Parameter _from is consumed by transferFrom().
Parameter _to is consumed by transferFrom().
Parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom() and propagates to unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter _from is checked against the ensure() whitelist.
Parameter _value is checked by ensure().
ensure() forwards _value to condition().
Parameter a supplies the arbitrary delegatecall target address.
Parameter b supplies arbitrary calldata for the delegatecall.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token is scaled and stored into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken is scaled and stored into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos controls the batchSend() loop recipients.
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
Parameter addr becomes tradeAddress, trusted by ensure().
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
Parameter _value is stored as the approved allowance.
Local total holds the overflow-prone _value * _tos.length product used for the balance check.
Local _to is the per-iteration recipient credited in batchSend().
Local loop index i drives the batchSend() iteration.
